validate_alcatraz.scope: Native YAML bindings, file hashes, route dimensions, discrete stationary obstacle samples and native mesh/box floor support only. Operable mission doors are assumed open on exit routes; stair treads and dynamic actor colliders are excluded from obstacle samples. Swept physics, NPC avoidance, Unity import, Play Mode and a player build are unverified.

validate_character_forward.scope: FBX source anatomy, forward gait, and orientation math under both reflection conventions; Unity playback unverified

validate_supplied_assets.scope: Native source references, glTF dependencies, byte hashes and static triangle floor samples; Unity import, physics and Play Mode unverified

validate_supplied_prison.scope: Native prefab bindings, retained geometry, native mesh/box floor support and discrete static box clearance; Unity import and swept physics unverified

validate_warehouse.scope: Archive hashes, native meshes, UV alignment, fitted sizes, barrel separation, five-point floor support and conservative stationary clearance. Unity compilation, live contacts and swept collision remain unverified.

validate_extra_assets.scope: Native prefab/material/texture references, catalog provenance, placement/equipment registration and supplied ZIP hashes/CRC. Unity import and gameplay are unverified.

validate_police_helicopter.scope: Native source triangle counts, police texture/renderer references and URP glass settings. Equipment fitting is reviewed in offline previews; Unity rendering and flight physics are unverified.

startup.scope: Serialized startup bindings only; Unity import, compilation and Play Mode remain unverified.

native_integrity.visual_qa: Separate Mesa geometry previews; not Unity render captures

csharp_grammar.scope: C# syntax grammar only; Unity API/type resolution and shader compilation are unverified

negative_startup_regressions.case: old supplied scene missing native audio listener

player and ancestor transforms must be active with nonzero scale
